採用・広告の製品.quote: Antibody-drug conjugates are a potent modality in need of improvement. Whether it’s successfully treating more patients or overcoming drug resistance, we need new designs for ADCs.
Bispecific antibody-drug conjugates allow for “gating” of how the therapeutic binds to a cancer cell based on the presence of either or both of two molecular targets on the surface of the cell.

At Valink, we go beyond binary gating. We discover and develop drugs that respond more effectively tuned to continuous levels of each target, whether in cancer or other diseases. We call this approach “V-Gate".
Our Mission is to build more effective drugs that can differentiate disease from healthy cells. We will create drugs that minimise side effects, enable new payloads and cure more people.

Valink is powered by the LiliumX® platform, a proprietary discovery engine built on three pillars: synthetic protein biology, high-throughput functional screening, and AI. This platform broadly explores the field of bispecific ADCs to identify potential drugs no one else can find.
Using these powerful tools, we are currently advancing three oncology-focused programs.

Press Release: Valink Therapeutics Closes $11.8 Million Pre-A Financing Round to Advance Oncology Pipeline
Valink Therapeutics Closes $11.8 Million Pre-A Financing Round to Advance Oncology Pipeline
Funding accelerates development of novel therapeutics to improve outcomes for patients with cancer

Valink’s bsADC technology aims to address key limitations of current ADCs by integrating novel targeting strategies with improved payload delivery. The company is also exploring complementary therapeutic modalities to broaden its impact across multiple cancer indications.

The financing was led by European venture capital fund redalpine, with participation from new investors LongeVC and Oxford Science Enterprises. Existing investors RV Invest, p53 Invest, Hoxton Ventures, Saras Capital and Oxonian Ventures also contributed to the round.

This financing strengthens our position as a leader in next-generation bispecific ADCs and supports the advancement of our oncology pipeline toward key milestones. Our V-gate approach and proprietary drug discovery engine expand the frontier of antibody drug conjugates, offering the potential for first-in-class medicines to address areas of high unmet need in oncology and beyond.

At redalpine, we back technologies that reshape paradigms. Valink’s discovery platform and V-gate approach represent a compelling advancement on traditional ADC strategies - unlocking new therapeutic possibilities by fusing programmable biology and a novel framework for target synergy,
We’re excited to lead this round and support Valink’s mission to address real-world disease biology with precision and adaptability.
LongeVC, an international biotech and longevity VC with a track record of supporting early-stage antibody-drug-conjugate companies, highlighted Valink’s approach's impact on oncology innovation: “
Antibody-drug conjugates are at a turning point, and Valink is among the few pushing the field beyond incremental improvements,
Valink’s V-gate platform unlocks new therapeutic logic for oncology. We’re proud to back a team that is pairing scientific depth with clear execution.

We’re excited about the progress Valink Therapeutics has made by leveraging the power of its technology platform to create truly differentiated therapeutic assets. RVI is happy to welcome redalpine as a new investor and is looking forward to shaping the company’s future together.
